body.speaker: Abdullah bhai
body.text_en: the Naatiq is saahib-e-naasut. And the Imam is saahib-e-naasut wa laahut, both.

body.speaker: Abdullah bhai
body.text_en: all the Nutqa' - Adam, Nuh, Ibrahim (alayhis salam), all of them - were only saahib-e-naasut, they were not saahib-e-laahut.

body.speaker: Abdullah bhai
body.text_en: from the gunaah (sin) of a mo'min, a kaafir is created. He says that the kaafir has no wujud (existence), that the gunaah (sin) we commit, Allah ta'ala gives it the shakl (shape) in the soorat (form) of a kaafir.

body.speaker: Abu Malik
body.text_en: knowledge is the lost camel of the believer, and an increase in knowledge is better than its lack.

body.speaker: Abu Malik
body.text_en: Words of wisdom are like jewels. Observed in the sunlight they sparkle; left alone, they do not lose value.

body.speaker: Abu Malik
body.text_en: those who were pleased by their own sound intellect and rejoiced in the knowledge they possessed, assuming they had encompassed everything from Allah's command. They said, he reminds them, that Allah would never send a messenger after their messenger.

body.speaker: Ahmad
body.text_en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of fathers and mothers, Creator of animals and plants. To Him belongs all that is in the earth and the heavens, and He bestows favor upon His creation with blessings. Beings have no existence except by His command, and beings have no existence except by His decree. His destiny is firm, so that the minds do not deny it, and it endures, so that it does not suffer from it.

body.speaker: al-Bakhtari
body.text_en: Today Salih is my father, and I am his son, and Salih is with his Lord.

body.speaker: al-Bakhtari
body.text_en: No. Salih is not dead, nor will he ever die; indeed he abides with Allah for all eternity.

body.speaker: Ali Wajih
body.text_en: You can cut off my neck, but bara'ah from Ali will not happen. Do whatever you want. Bara'ah from Ali will not happen.

body.speaker: Allah Ta'ala
body.text_en: you cannot guide anyone. You cannot guide anyone. Whatever is related to guidance is from Us.

body.speaker: Allah
body.text_en: O Son of Mary! First admonish your own soul (Nafs); then, if it accepts your counsel, admonish others — otherwise have shame before Me.

body.arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَا آتَيْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًا
body.speaker: Allah Ta'ala
body.text_en: fa-wajada 'abdan min 'ibadina ataynahu rahmatan min 'indina wa-'allamnahu min ladunna 'ilma (and he found a servant from among Our servants to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him knowledge from Our own presence).

body.speaker: Allah Ta'ala
body.text_en: an iqdhifihi fi al-yamm (Cast him into the river).

body.arabic: فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
body.speaker: Allah
body.text_en: `f-as'alu ahl al-zikr in kuntum la ta'lamun` (so ask the people of remembrance if you do not know).

body.speaker: Allah
body.text_en: Why are you so sad, O Zakariyya? Allah will grant you a ghulam (boy), will grant a son, who will be your successor, and who...

body.speaker: Allama Iqbal
body.text_en: Kabhi aye Haqiqat-e-Muntazar, nazar aa libas-e-majaz mein, ke hazaron sajde tadap rahe hain meri jabin-e-niyaz mein (O Awaited Reality, appear sometime in the garment of metaphor, for thousands of prostrations are writhing on my forehead of supplication).

body.speaker: Amir al-Mu'minin
body.text_en: if a believer comes to me who is unaware of the sharī'at, I will crush his nose.

body.speaker: Amir al-Mu'minin
body.text_en: anal-yaqut al-ahmar (I am the red ruby). Anal-yaqut al-ahmar... wa Rasulullah salawatullahi 'ala al-yaqut al-asfar (I am the red ruby... and the Messenger of Allah, may Allah's blessings be upon him, is the yellow ruby).

body.speaker: Ansaar bhai
body.text_en: Mawlana Ali's naasut, the naasut-e-taba'i, was very high. It was equivalent to the naasut-e-khaas of other a'imma. So for this reason, Mawlana Ali had to lower his own. So first you took the naasut-e-tanaasuli, but that too performed a very high function. So then you took the hijaab-e-naasut-e-tanaasuli, but that too was high. So you took the hijaab-e-hijaab-e-tanaasuli.

body.speaker: 'aql-e-awwal (First Intellect)
body.text_en: It must be that there is a creator of all of us.

body.speaker: 'aqle awwal (the first intellect)
body.text_en: Ke na main apne se kisi ko paida kar sakta hun, na koi mujhe paida kar sakta hai. Balke hum sab ka paida karne wala koi dusra hai.

body.speaker: Asghar Gondvi
body.text_en: Lau-e-Shama'-e-Haqiqat ki... Fanus ki gardish se kya kya nazar ata hai (The flame of the candle of reality... what all is seen from the revolution of the lantern).

body.speaker: Azar
body.text_en: Son, you do the work of buying and selling. I will go do some work and come back.

body.speaker: Azar
body.text_en: Brother, what has happened to the shop? Today, there has been a great calamity. All the idols are broken. And what have you done, Ibrahim?

body.speaker: Bab al-Abwab
body.text_en: This was your trust, I am the final limit (*hadd*), and after me is the Imam al-Zaman, I am giving it to you.

body.speaker: Ghazali
body.text_en: ostentation and show — Riya (performing the religious act for human applause rather than for Allah) — jealousy, arrogance, resentment, enmity, pride, and egotism.

body.speaker: Ghazali
body.text_en: Whatever answer you give, no matter how sound, such a person will regard you as an enemy, and the fire of envy within them will only burn more fiercely.

body.speaker: Ghazali
body.text_en: As far as possible, do not engage in religious debates with everyone, and do not argue with anyone on any matter — religious or otherwise — for there are many hidden harms within such disputes, and the harms far outweigh any benefits.

body.speaker: Ghazali
body.text_en: who has spent only a brief time acquiring knowledge, has not even begun to grasp intellectual and transmitted religious learning, and yet raises objections against scholars who have devoted their entire lives to those very disciplines. The depth of knowledge and insight possessed by a great scholar is entirely beyond their comprehension. That incomprehension itself is their foolishness.

body.speaker: Ghazali
body.text_en: Asking questions about religious and spiritual matters is like describing the diseases of the heart and their causes before a physician of the heart. And the efforts of that physician to cure those diseases are like the responses to the questions raised.

body.speaker: Ghazali
body.text_en: Whatever question this person asks, or whatever objection they raise, arises not from jealousy, fault-finding, or the desire to test, but from an earnest search for truth and correct guidance. This is the patient who can be cured. To answer the questions of such a person is therefore not merely permissible — it is obligatory (Wajib — religiously required).

body.speaker: Hasan al-Basri
body.text_en: I remembered the plea of the inhabitants of Hell when they will beseech the inhabitants of Paradise to pour upon them even a little water.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I glanced at the people and saw that everyone was running after the pleasures and desires of the Nafs (the lower self that incites one toward evil) and was subservient to its desires.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I looked at the people complaining against one another. I found that they were doing this on account of envy, jealousy, and enmity, and that the root cause was competition over greatness, grandeur, possessions, wealth, and knowledge.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: This alone is correct; this alone is the truth. The thoughts of the people of the world are false conjectures. Therefore I adopted Taqwa (pious reverence, consciousness, awe, and fear of Allah), so that I might be counted among those of the highest rank in the sight of Allah.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: After reaching this awareness and determination, I made my righteous deeds my beloved.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I saw that every person holds enmity toward someone else for some reason.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I saw that every person, through great pain and hard labour, was busy accumulating the possessions of this mortal world — money, wealth, goods — and was greatly pleased to have amassed much of it.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: From that time forward, I regarded Satan alone as my enemy and refused to obey any of his promptings. Instead, I cultivated obedience to Allah, followed His commandments, and devoted myself entirely to His worship and servitude.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I looked at the people of this world and saw that everyone has a beloved. Yet these beloveds — some accompany their lovers only until the illness that brings death, some until death itself, and some until the grave. After burial, all the loved ones return. None descend into the grave to dwell with the deceased, to offer companionship in the darkness, solitude, narrowness, and terror of that place.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I developed the certitude that the Wise Quran is correct. I then took a firm stand against my Nafs and was resolved to oppose it. I disciplined it to such a degree that I refused to fulfil any of its desires, until at last it began to find peace and satisfaction in the worship of Allah, the Exalted.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I reflected that Allah has appointed all possessions and ranks from the beginning of creation; no one has any control or say in this matter. Therefore I ceased to compete with or harbour jealousy toward anyone, and I remained content with Allah's distribution and with His appointed destiny, living in peace with all of creation by surrendering every jealousy and enmity against the creatures of God.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I saw that every person is preoccupied with his or her livelihood and the search for sustenance, consumed by intense effort in that pursuit. In this race, many do not even distinguish between the Halal (what is permissible) and the Haram (what is forbidden), and instead degrade themselves by pursuing doubtful and forbidden earnings.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I am also among those living creatures of God present upon the earth. Therefore I devoted myself to the worship of Allah and held firm to the certitude that He would bring my sustenance to

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: I looked at the people and saw that some believe grandeur and honour belong to the nation or tribe that is large and powerful; some believe it comes from abundance of wealth, possessions, family, and relatives; some believe it lies in displaying anger, in beating and killing and pillage; some believe it lies in wasteful spending — and so they take pride and boast in their respective fictions.

body.speaker: Hatim ibn Ism
body.text_en: Therefore whatever material possessions I had accumulated in this world, I spent entirely in the Way of Allah by distributing them among pious indigents and the needy, so that those possessions would be deposited with Allah as my trust, and would become a source of immense good and ransom — salvation — in the life hereafter.

body.speaker: Ghalib
body.text_en: Who can manage his praise, he is the servant of God. Who can manage the adornment of the highest paradise?

body.speaker: Hazrat Abdullah
body.text_en: Allah Ta'ala created 28 letters in the Spiritual Realm. And then those 28 letters performed a verb, an action, through which they received vowel points [zer, zabar, pesh] and dots and things like that happened.

body.speaker: Hazrat Asif Fyzee
body.text_en: I did not get it from the Majlis-e-Sulaymani Jawwad. And I... from Surat, from Burhanpur, from there I acquired it and printed this.

body.speaker: Hazrat Asif Fyzee
body.text_en: Until I get the command from my elder, at that time it was Sayyidna Taher Saifuddin, until then, we will not give it.

body.speaker: Hazrat Ibrahim (the Imam)
body.text_en: O people, what has happened to you that you worship idols? What are these statues to which you are devoted? Why do you worship idols? Why are you caught in this degradation and misguidance?

body.speaker: Hazrat Ibrahim
body.text_en: No, no, that's... that is fine. This is all in its place, but it doesn't mean that. Look, when the time comes, I will tell you, and you can leave at that time.

body.speaker: Henry Corbin
body.text_en: the letters of the divine names are not phonetic accidents but the metaphysical alphabet from which the cosmos is composed; to read the formula esoterically is to recover the procession by which being itself was articulated

body.speaker: Imam al-Ghazali
body.text_en: Of these eight admonitions, there are four things you must do and four things you must not do — so that your knowledge does not turn against you on the Day of Judgment.

body.speaker: Imam al-Ghazali
body.text_en: Do not deprive yourself of good deeds, do not neglect the knowledge of outward matters, and do not be without inner excellences and noble qualities of the heart. Be firmly convinced that knowledge alone, without righteous deeds, will not benefit you on the Day of Judgment.

body.speaker: Hazrat Maulana Shakir Sahab
body.text_en: Give such strength to my wings that I may reach my nest. A long time has passed since our nest was left behind by us.

body.speaker: Hazrat Zakariyya
body.text_en: O Allah, I wished I had a son who would be my waris (heir), and who... but what can I do, I have become za'if, and my hair has turned white, and so I... and there is no such thing as having hope for a child now. And my wife has also become old.

body.speaker: Imam al-Sadiq
body.text_en: Islam was established on seven pillars: *wilayah* (which is its most excellent, and through it and through the *wali* one reaches gnosis), and purity, and prayer, and zakah, and fasting, and hajj, and jihad.

body.speaker: Imam Ali
body.text_en: When the intellect reaches its perfection, speech diminishes.

body.speaker: Imam Ali
body.text_en: These questions are ordinary, what answer should I give? My children will give it.

body.speaker: Imam Ali
body.text_en: The teacher of others is more in need of teaching than they are

body.speaker: Imam Ali
body.text_en: People are of three sorts — a divine scholar, a learner upon the path of salvation, and the lowly common rabble who follow every screamer and bend wit

body.speaker: Imam Ali
body.text_en: Whoever is mindful of God, God prepares a way out for him from every difficulty

body.speaker: Imam the Fatimid caliph
body.text_en: the human being is the purpose of the second world and the end of the action of nature.

body.speaker: Iqbal
body.text_en: Humans are proud of the power of their speech, [but] the ignorant do not have the etiquette to speak.

body.speaker: Janab-e-Jalali Sahab
body.text_en: Sir, you do not know the definition (ta'rif) of prostration. What is prostration called? Prostration is that in which the limbs, our seven limbs, that is, both knees, both our hands, and the forehead here, and the two feet. These six and one seven, seven limbs, when they touch the ground, only then is it a prostration. This is not a prostration.

body.speaker: Janab Ibrahim (the Nabi)
body.text_en: What can I do? An old woman brought this offering. All of them pounced on this offering, and this commotion happened.

body.speaker: Janab Ibrahim (the Nabi)
body.text_en: Brother, what can I do? Look, ask your gods. All your gods have fought amongst themselves. What can I do?

body.speaker: Janab Ibrahim (the Nabi)
body.text_en: Brother, you say something, but this idol doesn't say anything. It doesn't know how to speak, it doesn't do anything, this poor thing isn't saying a word. Why are you making such a fuss?

body.speaker: Janab Ibrahim (the Nabi)
body.text_en: Brother, what will you do with this idol? They don't speak, they don't express anything, they don't feel pain, they don't... it is of no harm, nor can they express happiness. What do you do with such idols?

body.speaker: Janab Ibrahim (the Nabi)
body.text_en: Your offering has been accepted by them, and these gods have given you many prayers. You can go.

body.speaker: Janab Umar
body.text_en: 'bring, extend your hand, I will give you my...' ...I do it. I give bay'ah (pledge of allegiance).

body.speaker: Libyan ambassador
body.text_en: What is this? First it's the bow and then the prostration. This is not permissible in Islam and this is wrong.

body.speaker: Luqman
body.text_en: My son! Do not let the rooster prove more intelligent than you. Let it not be that he rises in the last part of the night to proclaim the hour of remembrance and glorifies his Lord, while you remain sunk in the deep sleep of heedlessness, carelessness, and negligence.

body.speaker: Maulana 'Ali
body.text_en: he sees up to seven generations if there is a mu’min

body.speaker: Maulana Mu‘izz
body.text_en: O Nu'man, you too should codify our shari‘ah.

body.speaker: Mawla 'Ali
body.text_en: This is the silent Book of Allah, and I am the speaking Book of Allah.

body.speaker: Mawla Amir al-Mu'minin
body.text_en: Bring me down from divinity, and then say whatever you wish about me. Lower me from divinity, O people, do not make me God (Rabb). Lower me from divinity, and then say whatever comes to your heart about me.

body.speaker: Mawla-e-Ka'inat
body.text_en: Whoever comes to me ignorant, I will break their nose, whether male or female believer.

body.speaker: Mawlana Ali
body.text_en: I seek refuge in You, O Allah, from disbelief, poverty, greed, and envy. from poverty and indigence... and doubt and hypocrisy and evil... and evil character.

body.speaker: Mawlana Dr. Saheb
body.text_en: the tahajjud (late-night prayer) is not just one, there are many tahajjuds.

body.speaker: Mawlana Husayn
body.text_en: What are you doing, Ali? My Imamat will be established through you. Meaning, you are the remainder.

body.speaker: Mawlana Ja'far al-Sadiq
body.text_en: fi'l-imamati mutamathilun (in Imamate they are alike) and wa fi'l-darajati mutafadilun (and in ranks they are different).

body.speaker: Prophet 'Isa (Jesus)
body.text_en: with the permission of God — not incapable of restoring the dead to life, yet he was incapable of curing the fool and the ignorant.

body.speaker: Mother of Musa
body.text_en: O Allah, what should I do for my child? You alone guide me.

body.speaker: Noble Prophet
body.text_en: The subtle bodies of our Shia are like our dense bodies. That the subtle bodies (lataif) of our Shia are our dense bodies (kasaif).

body.arabic: مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ
body.speaker: Noble Prophet
body.text_en: ma la `aynun ra'at wa la uzunun sami`at wa la khatara `ala qalbi bashar (what no eye has seen, nor ear has heard, nor has it occurred to the heart of a man)

body.speaker: Old woman
body.text_en: I have brought this offering as a gift and I present it to these idols.

body.speaker: Prophet 'Isa
body.text_en: The condition of the world is also like this. What is the point of building a house here?

body.arabic: مَنْ كُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ فَهَذَا عَلِيٌّ مَوْلَاهُ
body.speaker: Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: man kuntu mawlahu fa-hadha 'aliyyun mawlahu (Of whomsoever I am the master, Ali is his master).

body.speaker: Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: whoever supports me today will be my khalifa (successor), my wasi (legatee), and my janishin (heir).

body.speaker: Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: is there anyone who will support me and aid me?

body.speaker: Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: If I tell you that a large army is coming from behind this Faran mountain that will attack you, will you accept my word?

body.speaker: Qadi al-Nu'man
body.text_en: Maulana, this is Kalam al-muluk, muluk al-kalam. What can I say about your words? It contains the best of the best things.

body.speaker: Qadi al-Nu'man
body.text_en: Everyone came, illa Ja‘far. Except for Ja‘far, everyone came.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: You say Allah is one — written with four letters, two joined and two separate. Which is 'one'? And the word Allah is also written with four letters — which of them is 'Allah'? Are they Allah together, or are they signs pointing to Allah?

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: Allah is a name for Allah? Then what is the difference between the name and the one named — and which one do you worship?

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: Jewels are useful, he says, only where there is no confusion between a real jewel and forged glass.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: So Allah's just witness follows the accustomed way of His prophets: persevering under persecution, and remaining hidden until Allah judges between him and us.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: It is like saying fire is hot. True — but you cannot cook food with the words, nor brighten darkness without the reality of fire. If nouns and adjectives could take the place of realities, your tongue would burn at the mere mention of fire, and your hunger would be satiated at the mention of food.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: Those are only names and descriptions, of no benefit without their essential realities.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: And now your community has followed in the ways of those who preceded them.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: Every religion in which worship is based solely on transmitted reports should not be named religion at all.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: Every period has started with three types — a rebellious devil, a willing oppressor, and a hypocritical religious scholar.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: In the end it all boils down to one simple fact. Do you understand who Allah is, the reality behind His unity, or do you only have a textbook definition of that monotheism?

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: They no longer inquire as they should, because it has been imbued in their hearts that they are the true possessors of Allah's command, and that there will be no prophet after their prophet. This is exactly what was said by those who strayed before them, for every community claims there is no prophet after its own.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: Spiritual knowledge, he says, cannot be accepted as genuine until it has been presented to those who receive divine knowledge from the heavens. Only if they accept it can it be deemed genuine.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: Religion is one, purely upholding what is due to Allah without difference; while transmitted reports all differ from and deny one another.

body.speaker: Salih
body.text_en: But then which letters point to Him? When you say 'Allah,' you separate the first letter and join the remaining three letters. Which of these points to Him — the one by itself, or the others joined?

body.speaker: Qadi al-Nu'man
body.text_en: Maulana, this is Kalam al-muluk, muluk al-kalam. What can I say about your words? It contains the best of the best things.

body.speaker: Qadi al-Nu'man
body.text_en: Everyone came, illa Ja‘far. Except for Ja‘far, everyone came.

body.speaker: Sayyid al-Malik
body.text_en: The books that should be by our bedside are two. One is the Qur'an al-Majeed, which we should be reciting day and night. It should be read. And the second thing which we must always read with discipline is Da'ā'im al-Islām.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Ali bin Hiba al-Makrami
body.text_en: The secrets gathered from the first of the Da'is, that is Sayyidna Dhu'ayb bin Musa, to him are the secrets with Sayyidna Sulayman bin Hasan.

body.speaker: Sayyidna 'Ali
body.text_en: out of five times, one time is when prayers are accepted. That is 'inda nuzul al-ghayth, meaning at the time of rainfall.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Ali
body.text_en: in our own body, in a believer's body, there are 360 nufus (souls/selves). And every nafs makes progress in every cycle.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Da'ud bin 'Ajabshah
body.text_en: You keep reading, and he will keep explaining to you. Because, his mere thought is better than your certainty.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Ghulam Husain Sahab
body.text_en: Look, brother, your sciences and our sciences up to Sayyidna Burhanuddin are one and the same... your `adwar` are also ours.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Isma'il
body.text_en: where there is theft or, you can say, loss, whether on land or at sea, all of it happens because of not paying `zakat` properly.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Ja'far al-Sadiq
body.text_en: there is a large circle, that is Islam. Within it is a smaller circle. The one in the smaller circle can claim to be in the larger circle too. But the one in the larger circle... a smaller circle is inside a larger circle. The one in the large circle cannot say he is in the smaller circle.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Ja'far al-Sadiq
body.text_en: Allah says, 'As you are, so shall it be for you.'

body.speaker: Sayyidna Mu'ayyad al-Shirazi
body.text_en: la tuksiranna ya Rabbi fi hadha al-safarana (O my Lord, do not prolong our journey in this). O... O Lord, in this world, do not prolong our journey.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Mu'ayyad Hibatullah bin Musa Shirazi
body.text_en: law kuntu 'asartu fi 'asri muhammadan ma qassartu rutbata 's-salmani (If I had lived in the time of Muhammad, my rank would not have been less than that of Salman).

body.speaker: Sayyidna sahib
body.text_en: the four groupings: the light luminous, the heavy luminous, the light tenebrous... Yes, that which is, of seven each. The third grouping, those are the letters of the speaking opposites, those seven.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Ziya' Ali Muqaddas
body.text_en: when the naasut and laahut of the Imam is formed, then whatever maqaam (station) the soorat takes in the laahut, for example if it took the maqaam of the eye, the maqaam of the left eye in the laahut, then in the naasut as well, it will take the maqaam of the left eye with it.

body.speaker: Shaykh Junaid Baghdadi
body.text_en: All discourses and spiritual signs turned out to be of no avail. But certain cycles of prayer I had performed during the Tahajjud were of benefit.

body.speaker: Shaykh Shafeeq
body.text_en: Bravo, O Hatim. You have said a most excellent thing.

body.speaker: Shaykh Sufyan al-Thawri
body.text_en: Allah the Exalted has created a wind that blows in the last part of the night. At that hour, the voices of those servants of Allah who engage in His remembrance and seek His forgiveness are carried by this wind and presented to the Court of Allah the Exalted.

body.speaker: Sheikh
body.text_en: But if your teacher is owned by another and does not own you, has he any right to free you?

body.speaker: Sheikh
body.text_en: That can only happen after the completion of seven days, in honor of the new-born infant.

body.speaker: Sheikh
body.text_en: How can we recognize something that has no name, even if it has been born?

body.speaker: The author of the book The Correction
body.text_en: I do not say that motion and stillness are born of the soul by force, learning them from the intellect; rather, I say that they are two effects of the soul by the power learned from the intellect in the image and the form, so that the image and the form became the foundation of this world.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Correction
body.text_en: As for the saying that the decree is prior and the destiny posterior — this is wrong, because destiny is before decree, and the prior is before the posterior.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Correction
body.text_en: Adam was the first to draw the lines of religion in command and prohibition. And whoever works to benefit from what the rest of the speaker-prophets drew in their apparent laws, what is inferred from the subtleties (the recommended meanings of the parables, called interpretation, which is the manifestation of the words of the wise), knows that every drawing pronounced, every command, prohibition, and act of servitude, is a law: small or great, few or many.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Correction
body.text_en: Whoever says that the beginning of the speaker-prophets (peace be upon them) had no sacred law is mistaken. He is also mistaken when he counts them among the determined ones (al-muqarrarun, those who copy or renew a prior sacred law), because determination occurs only by copying or renewing a sacred law that already exists, and the first Pronouncer had no sacred law preceding him to abrogate.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Correction
body.text_en: But to represent the denser with the body and the gentler with the soul, to read the body off the dense and the soul off the gentle,this is clear.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Correction
body.text_en: To represent the gentler with the soul and the denser with the body is premature

body.speaker: The author of the book The Correction
body.text_en: It is impossible to say that the people of that cycle were in such a state (without work, benefit, statutes, interpretation, inwardness, or real summons), because the mission rests on the sacred law; interpretation requires the revelation; the inner requires the outer; the meaning requires the parable. If there is no outer, then there is no inner, no call, and no sacred law; creation is neglected and the people are left in ignorance.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Correction
body.text_en: Motion and stillness are like the soul to form and hyle,because form and hyle are like the body to motion and stillness.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Defense
body.text_en: This statement contains some confusion, he said, for motion is only for the sake of seeking. The motion of fire upward is to seek its place; the motion of earth downward is to seek its place; the motion of souls is to seek benefit. When seeking is established, there is need, for seeking arises only from need. It is impossible to say that the intellect needs something for which it moves.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Defense
body.text_en: This is not the case of the soul and the body,where the measure between them is only the gentler and the denser.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Defense
body.text_en: To say that human beings are the fruit of this world is also the saying of the materialists, those who did not affirm the survival of the soul after the dissolution of bodies. For if human beings were the fruit of this world, this world would have held him and would not have let him move to another world.

body.speaker: The author of the book The Harvest
body.text_en: He is the creator of the thing — the rational thing, the illusory, the intellectual, the logical — I mean what is beneath these elements, and what is not beneath them.

body.speaker: The author of The Correction
body.text_en: the Second is born of the First, is not like the First, and yet resembles him, though the First is of higher rank and the more honorable station. Like the male and the female in every race and species. The male, even though he is higher and more honorable than the female, is nonetheless her counterpart and her likeness. The Second is the counterpart of the First in the rank below.

body.speaker: The author of The Defense
body.text_en: that the Talmanic spheres are born of the Soul although they do not resemble it, just as the Soul is born of the First although it does not resemble it. The Soul has fallen into a state of frailty and darkness because of its distance from the First Cause, and this is what made it possible to be born from the Soul. Likewise the diminution that fell upon the Soul, because it is beyond the First Cause, is what enables the further chain of generation.

body.speaker: the author
body.text_en: We are limbs of a single body, the body of the mission. The hand does not shame the foot, nor the eye the ear. When one limb sees a knot the other passed over, it is its right to tie it; that is the very meaning of being one body.

body.speaker: The author
body.text_en: the Second is like the First, even if it is in a lower rank, and the Foundation is like the Speaker, even if he is in a lower rank. The Second is, in its existence, that of which nothing remains in the form of a degree to be attained later, by which it would gain perfection. Just as the Foundation is perfect in his rank, with no degree left for him to ascend to and acquire. Yet the Second is not in himself complete.

body.speaker: the author
body.text_en: When I saw that Shaykh Jonathan (may God have mercy on him) had set out to correct, in the book the book The Harvest (The Harvest), what he claimed had been corrupted, and that Shaykh Samuel Samuel (Samuel, may God have mercy on him) had supported the author of the book The Harvest and judged his statement to be correct — I bore witness that what they disputed about was not among the branches in which disagreement is permissible while the soundness of the principles is preserved.

body.speaker: The book The Correction
body.text_en: Decree and destiny are two words whose meaning is known from speech: destiny is estimation, and decree is detail. There is no detail except after estimation, and the first is before the second by the farthest measure of priority.

body.speaker: the chief judge of the Fatimid court
body.text_en: the outer practice without the inner meaning is like a body without a soul, and the inner meaning without the outer practice is like a soul that has no body to walk the earth in.

body.speaker: The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali)
body.text_en: People are of three kinds — a divine scholar, a learner upon the path of salvation, and the riffraff and rabble who follow every screamer and bend with every wind

body.speaker: The Commander of the Faithful
body.text_en: The tongue of the wise is behind his heart, and the heart of the fool is behind his tongue.

body.speaker: The Commander of the Faithful
body.text_en: the perfection of sincerity toward Him is the denial of attributes to Him, because every attribute bears witness that it is other than the thing described, and every thing described bears witness that it is other than the attribute.

body.speaker: The Commander of the Faithful
body.text_en: Yes, O Allah, the earth is never devoid of one who establishes the proof of Allah, whether openly and renowned, or fearful and concealed, lest the proofs and clear signs of Allah be invalidated

body.speaker: The Commander of the Faithful
body.text_en: Faith is recognition by the heart, confession by the tongue, and action by the limbs

body.speaker: The Commander of the Faithful
body.text_en: Truth is not recognized by men; rather, recognize the truth and you will recognize its people

body.speaker: The Disciple
body.text_en: What is the matter with these people who sit in their assemblies pretending to resemble the prophets of resolution, agreeing that they alone uphold Allah's command? How is it that the learned scholars of this community have abandoned inquiry?

body.speaker: The disciple
body.text_en: for speech comes from a speaker described by his speech, and Allah is beyond such attributes.

body.speaker: The disciple
body.text_en: Anyone who imposes such an impossible obligation cannot be just. And Allah is far exalted above that.

body.speaker: The Father of Imams
body.text_en: lean of body" but their faces carry the light of nights spent in standing prayer; they do not abandon the world but pass through it lightly, "their souls chaste, their needs few, their bodies fasting through the day and standing through the night.

body.speaker: The Father of Imams
body.text_en: The most disabling of ignorance is a man's ignorance of his own soul

body.speaker: The father
body.text_en: Is this how sons repay their fathers? You chose that stranger over me and supported his cause over the path of your forefathers. If what you found in him is truth, you betrayed me by concealing it. And if it is false, you destroyed yourself.

body.speaker: Shaytan
body.text_en: You created me from fire, and him You created from clay.

body.speaker: The astrologers
body.text_en: O King, we are seeing that a boy will be born in your kingdom who will destroy your kingdom. He will ruin your kingdom, and such a person is coming, we are seeing this in the stars.

body.speaker: The Imam (Maulana Mu‘izz)
body.text_en: Haza min maulak Ja‘far. This is written by your master, written by Ja‘far.

body.speaker: The Imam (Maulana Mu‘izz)
body.text_en: How is your health? What's the matter? O Qadi, who all came to your side to inquire about your health? Who all came, the prominent ones?

body.speaker: The Imam (Maulana Salim)
body.text_en: O Isa, your duty is over. I am relieving you. A great new Prophet is about to come.

body.speaker: The Imam (Maulana Salim)
body.text_en: O Isa, I will relieve you of your duties and include you in my circle and my assembly of da'is. And I will save you from the foul language and evil deeds of the disbelievers, the deniers. And until your era is complete, I will give all believers superiority and elevation over the deniers of the wasi.

body.speaker: The new ruler (son of the previous king)
body.text_en: When you honor your master so much and are in his obedience, then go, I release you. You will also be in our obedience.

body.speaker: the noble Prophet
body.text_en: The first thing that Allah created was the Intellect. So He said to it, 'Come forward,' and it came forward. Then He said to it, 'Go back,' and it went back. Through you I punish and through you I reward.

body.speaker: The people
body.text_en: Brother, after all, these are our idols, we worship them. Why are you humiliating them so much? What is this?

body.speaker: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him
body.text_en: My ummah will split into seventy-three sects, one of which will be saved.

body.speaker: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him
body.text_en: this is the sitting place of Shaitan. This is Shaitan's seat.

body.speaker: The Prophet, peace be upon him
body.text_en: I took from five, I gave to five, between me and my Lord are five.

body.arabic: مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ
body.speaker: The Prophet (alayhi al-salatu wa al-salam)
body.text_en: jannah (paradise) is that house where ma la 'aynun ra'at wa la udhunun sami'at wa la khatara 'ala qalb bashar (what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and what has not crossed the heart of man).

body.speaker: The Prophet (sallallahu 'alayhi wa-alihi)
body.text_en: I and Sa'at were walking together, and I went a little ahead. For instance, you said about the two fingers that two fingers are like this, and I have moved one step ahead.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: I was a Prophet when Adam was between water and clay.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: A servant's preoccupation with useless matters is a sign that Allah has withdrawn His special favor from him. And if even a single moment of a servant's life passes in pursuit of something other than that for which Allah created him, then that is a matter of profound sorrow.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: Whoever says there is no god but Allah will enter Paradise.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: Fulfilling its rights and knowing its limits.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: I seek Allah's refuge from knowledge that is of no benefit.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: On the Day of Judgment, the most severe torment will be visited upon the scholar whom Allah did not benefit through his knowledge — that is, one who did not act upon what he acquired.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: Whoever says there is no god but Allah... with sincerity, will enter Paradise.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: An individual whose condition, even after forty years of age, is such that the good within him does not prevail over the evil, should prepare to go to Hell.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: Say there is no god but Allah and you will be successful.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: every nabi (prophet) was given an opponent, meaning a shaytan. Every nabi has a shaytan. You know, who was it for Musa 'alayh al-salam? Fir'awn (Pharaoh). Who was it for Ibrahim? Namrud. In this way, in every era, there has been a shaytan. But the Prophet says that for me, there are two shaytans.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: O Ali, you are my wasi here and in the hereafter.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: Hasan and Husayn are two Imams of truth, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than them both.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: I am leaving among you two weighty things, the Book of Allah and my Family; they will never separate until they reach me at the pool.

body.speaker: The Rasulullah (Prophet Muhammad)
body.text_en: you should start every act with Bismillah, so that your every act will be blessed.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: I have no words of my own, for I am following the words of another.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: I am his spiritual son, and one of his beautiful works, constantly seeking his satisfaction and fearing his wrath.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: The Air is too exalted to be a symbol for any creation.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: is Air. Higher than heaven and earth. Encompassing everything and encompassed by nothing. It is the loftiest similitude, pointing to the One who has no likeness.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: Indeed Allah will protect you from his, and other people's, hostility.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: What, then, could symbolize Air? There is none like Air.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: For just as every word has a proper employment that can only be accepted if it is sincere and true, similarly knowledge is of no benefit until it has been put into action, and action is of no benefit until it is accepted by Allah. And the only thing Allah accepts is sincerity.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: Keep the purification portion entrusted to him by its rightful master — until you meet him. For he is the most rightful judge, for you and against you.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: You purify your possessions through charity just as you purify your body through righteous acts. Righteous acts are a protection; charity is a purification.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: He did not say "nothing is like Him," because He has no likeness; rather He meant that the sign pointing to Him is not like other signs. None of the signs pointing to His creations is like His sign.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: I have no need of it. I have left behind worldly possessions and fled from the conflicts and temptations of wealth.

body.speaker: The scholar
body.text_en: a sign pointing to the One who has no likeness — neither in the outward aspects nor the inner.

body.speaker: The young man
body.text_en: Indeed I am an infant in relation to what I wish to achieve, so raise and educate me.

body.speaker: Young man
body.text_en: Then I am the freed man, son of the servant of Allah.

body.speaker: Young man
body.text_en: I have been born to you. So give me a name.

body.arabic: كُنْتُ نَبِيًّا وَآدَمُ بَيْنَ الْمَاءِ وَالطِّينِ
body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: I was a Prophet when Adam was between water and clay.

body.arabic: مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: Whoever says there is no god but Allah will enter Paradise.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: Fulfilling its rights and knowing its limits.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: no one recognized Hazrat Ali except for me and God.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: he did not recognize God with the recognition He deserves, but whatever recognition was achieved, it was by me and Ali. And no one recognized me except Ali and God. And no one recognized Ali except God and me.

body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: Whoever says there is no god but Allah... with sincerity, will enter Paradise.

body.arabic: قُولُوا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ تُفْلِحُوا
body.speaker: The Prophet Muhammad
body.text_en: Say there is no god but Allah and you will be successful.

body.arabic: مَنْ عَرَفَ نَفْسَهُ فَقَدْ عَرَفَ رَبَّهُ
body.speaker: The Prophet of the Lord of the worlds
body.text_en: Man 'arafa nafsahu faqad 'arafa Rabbahu (He who knows himself knows his Lord). The one who recognized his own self, he recognized his Lord.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: every nabi (prophet) was given an opponent, meaning a shaytan. Every nabi has a shaytan. You know, who was it for Musa 'alayh al-salam? Fir'awn (Pharaoh). Who was it for Ibrahim? Namrud. In this way, in every era, there has been a shaytan. But the Prophet says that for me, there are two shaytans.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: O Ali, you are my wasi here and in the hereafter.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: Hasan and Husayn are two Imams of truth, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than them both.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: he is a kāfir (disbeliever) and a Muslim has no connection with him.

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: in praising Janāb-i-Alī, you can say whatever you wish. If someone says something you think is a lie, don't deny it. Did you see? If there is something in praise of Mawlā that you consider a lie, do not deny it; you might just not be able to understand it.

body.speaker: The Rasulullah (Prophet Muhammad)
body.text_en: you should start every act with Bismillah, so that your every act will be blessed.

body.speaker: The Sadiq (the Truthful One)
body.text_en: A lie is totally a lie. A lie is not connected to any expediency (maslahat) or any other consideration. A lie is a lie. Al-kizbu kizbun (a lie is a lie).

body.speaker: Umar ibn al-Khattab
body.text_en: Had it not been for 'Ali, 'Umar would have perished.

body.speaker: Umar ibn al-Khattab
body.text_en: Women are incapable of giving birth to the like of 'Ali ibn Abi Talib.
